title: ABI surface requires a rootfs manifest

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: ABI guarantees come from a selected rootfs manifest and accounted shared-library closure, not from successfully starting Emacs once.
hypothesis: The current development Insula may inventory the Emacs dynamic-library surface, but it should not claim an ABI guarantee without a rootfs manifest.
minimal_fixture: The running Emacs binary plus the emitted Insula plan.
predicted_behavior: Development mode reports `abi_guarantee=none'; production mode must report a selected rootfs or ABI manifest.

derived_gym_requirement: The Soma Insula contract must make ABI-relevant library/toolchain identity part of rootfs materialization and benchmark evidence.
